_note: Mastery is DMZ's own, from the same blog: Chiral 2,500 Tier 3+ enemy kills, Ripple Tide exfil 2 LT dog tags in one deployment 50 times, Helio 25,000 Legendary weapon kills on a max-level Operator. Military and Special unlockLevels copied from Multiplayer's in-game screens (16 Oct 2026; weapon level is shared). Special names and challenges are placeholders until this mode's own camo screens are seen. Mastery images are real; tier 2/3 challenges in game: 'Get &&2 Tier 3+ enemy kills and then successfully exfil &&1 times', 'Get &&2 1 shot headshot enemy kills with max level operators and then successfully exfil &&1 times'. DMZ Mastery 2 (Ripple Tide) and 3 (Helio) from @brokealx on 17 Oct 2026, with a clip: these replace the recording's placeholder wording (Tier 3+ kills then exfil; one-shot headshots on max-level operators then exfil), which the game appears to have changed.
